items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; security-sensitive releases and new public exposure are blocked. Evidence is incomplete because fleet-doctor has no run, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps are unavailable, and authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. No active vulnerability is established. Risk severity is high evidence uncertainty, not a confirmed compromise. TLS has no certificates expiring within 30 days, but coverage is unverified. Recommendation: continue only bounded read-only evidence work; allow ordinary reversible growth conditionally when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Security recommendation for the gated product: keep private and preview-only. Public exposure, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising expansion, and security-sensitive deployment remain blocked until access boundaries, secret handling, data flow and retention, release and dependency controls, monitoring, incident procedures, TLS, and disclosure readiness are directly evidenced alongside legal, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates.
